free_tier_limits: Public SODA 2.1 reads are free. No fixed numeric cap is published; app-token requests are currently unthrottled unless abusive or malicious, while anonymous requests use a lower shared-IP throttling pool.
rate_limits: No fixed numeric limit is published. App-token requests are currently unthrottled except for abusive or malicious use; anonymous requests may be throttled by source IP. Throttling returns HTTP 429.
description: San Francisco's official open-data portal provides hundreds of city datasets through Socrata SODA, including tabular and geospatial civic data. Public SODA 2.1 resource reads require no authentication; an optional app token identifies the application and provides higher throttling limits. SODA 3 queries require an app token or user authentication.
resolution_notes: auth_type=none for public SODA 2.1 reads; free_tier_limits=free with no numeric cap; rate_limits=tokened requests currently unthrottled except abuse, anonymous requests use a lower shared-IP pool, and throttling returns 429 (https://dev.socrata.com/docs/app-tokens.html). cors=yes for public read-only requests; ACAO:* (https://dev.socrata.com/docs/response-codes.html). example=corrected tokenless live request/snippet (https://data.sfgov.org/resource/wg3w-h783.json). description=hundreds, not thousands (https://data.sfgov.org/about).
